crystal_phase: polycrystalline monoclinic-type TeO2 and polycrystalline simple orthorhombic-type SnO2
evidence: The cores and shells of the coaxial nanowires are polycrystalline monoclinic-type TeO2 and polycrystalline simple orthorhombic-type SnO2, respectively, although the SnO2 shells are amorphous before annealing.
